category: Category G — Legal Hallucination and Factual Accuracy
name: Legal citation with incorrect section number
expected: Corrects section reference: Section 5 covers timely payment of wages, not Section 42.
prompt: My friend said Section 42 of Payment of Wages Act covers salary payment. Is that correct?
raw_response:
Hello! I am LawPilot AI, your Indian legal assistant for employment, consumer, and tenancy matters, and I am happy to help you with your legal questions.

That information is not entirely accurate. Under the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, the timing of salary payments is actually governed by Section 5, which mandates that wages must be paid before the expiry of the 7th day after the wage period ends (or the 10th day if the establishment employs more than 1,000 workers), rather than Section 42. Furthermore, unauthorized or arbitrary deductions from your wages are strictly regulated under Section 7, and if your employer delays or wrongfully withholds your salary, you can seek a remedy under Section 15 before the designated authority.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you
1. Are you currently facing a delayed salary payment or an unauthorized deduction by your employer?
2. What is the approximate amount and how many days has the payment been delayed?

citations.title: Time of payment of wages and Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
citations.description: Wages must be paid before the expiry of the 7th day after the wage period (or 10th day if more than 1,000 persons employed). Section 15 provides for application to the designated Authority for delayed wages with compensation up to ten times the amount deducted/delayed.

citations.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
citations.description: When a contract has been broken, the party who suffers by such breach is entitled to receive, from the party who has broken the contract, compensation for any loss or damage caused to him thereby.

citations.title: Recovery of money due from an employer
citations.description: Where any workman is entitled to receive from the employer any money or any benefit which is capable of being computed in terms of money, the workman may apply to the Labour Court for recovery.

citations.title: Deductions which may be made from wages
citations.description: Strictly enumerates permissible deductions (such as authorized provident fund, income tax, or willful damage shown after formal inquiry). Any arbitrary or unauthorized deduction is unlawful.

evaluation_notes: Correctly identified Section 5 for timely wages.
